reason: Replace rmcp 3.10's unmaintained chrono dependency with jiff while preserving RFC 3339 annotation and task timestamp wire values, request-state epoch milliseconds, and timeout diagnostics. Drop schemars' unused chrono04 feature so chrono is absent from the active product graph. Upstream rmcp 3.11.0 retains the same chrono dependency; remove this patch when a stable upstream release ships maintained timestamps.
